title: RAG-KG-IL: A Multi-Agent Hybrid Framework for Reducing Hallucinations and Enhancing LLM Reasoning through RAG and Incremental Knowledge Graph Learning Integration

defines.name: RAG-KG-IL
defines.definition: A multi-agent hybrid framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, and incremental learning to reduce hallucinations and improve LLM reasoning with continuously updated knowledge.

problem: LLMs struggle to reason with structured knowledge, adapt to dynamic knowledge updates, and avoid hallucinations in mission-critical settings.
